headline: Coastal Sectors Erupt As Stlican Shelf And Godcrofts Face Heavy Turnover
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, intense tactical shifts have migrated toward the coastal and island sectors, with Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts recording rapid turnover. Stlican Shelf logged eight strategic-base events in the last two hours alone across disputed points including Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn, while Godcrofts posted five rapid transfers around Argosa, Lipsia, and Exile. Fighting has similarly re-ignited along Farranac Coast, registering four base actions in the two-hour window at Scythe and Mara. In Kings Cage, enlistments and casualties accelerated violently over the past hour as two base events shook Den of Knaves, while Stonecradle maintained brisk action at The Long Fast and Loch Mor recorded a capture at Mercy's Wish. Though strategic-base ownership stabilized over the past two hours in Weathered Expanse and Dead Lands, both sectors endured staggering attrition, with Weathered Expanse absorbing over twenty-eight hundred combined casualties in that span. In contrast, prior hotbeds such as Callahan's Passage, Fisherman's Row, and Oarbreaker have settled into sustained operational lulls.
